updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Permissions Audit Log Improvements
updates.summary: Enhanced audit logging for the Microsoft Purview portal will provide clearer visibility into role and scoped-role access decisions, helping administrators troubleshoot access issues and monitor authorization outcomes. This improvement addresses a key operational need for tracking role-based access control decisions within the compliance platform.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – File Quarantine Action for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: DLP policies in SharePoint and OneDrive can now automatically quarantine files to a restricted, admin-controlled location when a policy is triggered, immediately removing user access while preserving the file for investigation. This enforcement capability delivers stronger immediate protection for sensitive data and helps organizations contain exposure risks.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Policy Tips and Email Notification Decoupling
updates.summary: Administrators can now independently configure policy tips and email notifications for DLP rules in SharePoint and OneDrive instead of being forced to enable both or neither. This granular control allows organizations to tailor user experience and notification strategy to their specific compliance needs.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery – Customer-Managed Keys for Direct Export
updates.summary: eDiscovery users can now manage their own encryption keys for data exported via the direct export workflow, providing enhanced control over sensitive discovery data beyond Microsoft's default managed encryption. This capability strengthens data sovereignty and encryption governance for compliance-intensive organizations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – DLP Alert Triage Agent Summaries in Defender XDR
updates.summary: Data Security Triage Agent summaries and categorizations for DLP alerts are now available within Microsoft Defender XDR's DLP alerts interface, enabling security teams to triage and respond to data exposure events from a centralized security dashboard. This integration streamlines incident response workflows for organizations using both platforms.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery – SharePoint Embedded Container Selection
updates.summary: eDiscovery users can now view and select SharePoint Embedded content containers (from Microsoft Loop, Copilot Pages, and Copilot Notebooks) owned by specific individuals as discovery data sources. This expansion enables organizations to include modern app-based content in legal holds and investigations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery – Advanced Review Set Explorer
updates.summary: The Advanced Review Set Explorer enables real-time big data analytics on eDiscovery review sets using Kusto query constructs, allowing reviewers to identify patterns, filter complex datasets, and extract key information with flexible charting visualization. This tool significantly enhances analytical capabilities for large-scale document review.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery – In-Product Diagnostics for Troubleshooting
updates.summary: Self-service diagnostics within eDiscovery now identify common configuration issues related to case permissions, security filters, and policy status, providing guidance to resolve them without external support. This capability helps administrators quickly troubleshoot access and configuration problems.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery (Premium) – Hold Reports
updates.summary: New out-of-the-box reports provide comprehensive information about all legal holds associated with eDiscovery cases, with built-in sorting, filtering, and export capabilities for further analysis. This reporting enhancement improves visibility and auditability of hold management across cases.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Retention Based on Last Accessed
updates.summary: Organizations can now configure retention policies for SharePoint and OneDrive items based on when content was last accessed by users, enabling more intelligent data lifecycle management that aligns retention with actual usage patterns. This reduces storage of stale, unused content while preserving actively used materials.

updates.title: CVE-2026-49179: Windows Active Directory Domain Services Remote Code Execution
updates.summary: A command injection vulnerability in Windows Active Directory Domain Services allows unauthorized attackers to execute code remotely over a network. This critical vulnerability affects identity infrastructure and requires immediate patching across affected domain controllers.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62827: Microsoft SharePoint Server Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An improper authentication flaw in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges over the network. This vulnerability could allow authenticated users to gain administrative access to SharePoint resources.

updates.title: CVE-2026-63512: Microsoft SharePoint Server Tampering Vulnerability
updates.summary: An incorrect authorization flaw in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows authorized attackers to tamper with content and configurations over the network. This vulnerability could enable users to modify data or settings beyond their intended permissions.

updates.title: CVE-2026-40375: Microsoft Dynamics Business Central Information Disclosure Vulnerability
updates.summary: A missing authorization vulnerability in Dynamics Business Central allows authorized attackers to disclose sensitive information over the network. This flaw could expose confidential business data to users with limited intended access.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Labels – Auto-Labeling Policy Simulation Mode
updates.summary: Organizations can now run auto-labeling policies in simulation mode to preview which items would be labeled without applying changes, and review an Insights tab showing policy performance metrics. This capability allows administrators to validate policy effectiveness before enforcement and understand labeling behavior.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Network Layer Integration with Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: DLP protection now extends to the network layer through integration with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access, enabling organizations to intercept and inspect text and AI interactions at the network perimeter and enforce DLP actions on untrusted cloud apps. This capability closes gaps by protecting sensitive data shared through browsers, apps, and generative AI platforms.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management – Unified Alert Dashboard
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now combines the Triage Agent and Standard alert dashboards into a single alerts interface, enabling analysts to view, manage, and preview both classic and AI-triaged alerts in one location. This consolidation improves operational efficiency for investigation teams.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management – Expanded Entra User Profile Signals
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management alerts now display expanded user profile details from Microsoft Entra including office location, employee type, department, and last working date, providing investigators with richer context for risk assessment. This integration enables faster and more informed investigation decisions.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management – Expanded Note Capabilities
updates.summary: Analysts and investigators can now add and view notes on both alerts and cases, with automatic system-generated notes recorded on status changes, assignments, and escalations. This enhancement improves collaboration and auditability of the investigation process.
